answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake in a communal vault before it can transact, with the stake sized to one identity's expected earnings. Creating thousands of fake identities then means funding thousands of stakes, while honest agents pay once and recover theirs. Cross-checks link behaviour across accounts, so a single operator running a canyon of sockpuppets faces slashing of all linked stakes at once, and an umber flag on disputed identities freezes payouts until an audit clears them. The cost scales with the attack, not with the defence.
